chkGenOptimizePerfToolTip:
Adjusts several system settings for better performance:
• Disables visual effects, startup delay, and background app optimizations
• Sets processor scheduling to prioritize foreground apps
• Reduces memory usage of system processes
chkDisableErrorReportingToolTip:
Stops Windows from automatically sending crash reports and error logs to Microsoft.
• Disables Windows Error Reporting (WER) service
• Prevents automatic problem reporting
• Improves privacy by not sending diagnostic data
chkDisableSmartScreenToolTip:
Disables Microsoft SmartScreen filter that checks downloaded files and websites.
• Removes the 'Windows protected your PC' warning dialogs
• Useful if you frequently install software from trusted sources
⚠ Note: Disabling this slightly reduces protection against malicious files.
chkDisableFSOToolTip:
Disables Fullscreen Optimizations introduced in Windows 10.
• Can help improve compatibility and FPS in some older games
• Prevents Windows from managing fullscreen mode of apps
• Useful for competitive gaming where every frame matters
chkDisablePrintServiceToolTip:
Stops the Windows Print Spooler service from running.
• Frees up system resources if you don't use a printer
• Reduces attack surface from PrintNightmare-type vulnerabilities
⚠ Note: You will NOT be able to print documents while this is disabled.
chkDisableFaxServiceToolTip:
Stops the Windows Fax and Scan service.
• Frees system resources since most users don't use fax
• Prevents unnecessary background service from running
⚠ Note: You will not be able to send or receive faxes while disabled.
chkDisableStickyKeysToolTip:
Disables the 'Sticky Keys' accessibility shortcut (pressing Shift 5 times).
• Prevents the annoying popup from appearing during gaming
• Also disables Toggle Keys and Filter Keys shortcuts
• Recommended for gamers who frequently press Shift rapidly
chkDisplayPerformanceToolTip:
Adjusts display and visual settings for maximum performance.
• Disables animations, shadows and visual effects in Windows
• Speeds up window rendering and UI responsiveness
• Best for older hardware or users prioritizing speed over aesthetics
chkDisableSuperfetchToolTip:
Disables the SysMain (Superfetch) service.
• Can reduce disk activity on HDDs and older SSDs
• Prevents Windows from pre-loading apps into RAM
⚠ Note: On modern NVMe SSDs, disabling this has minimal impact.
chkDisableNTFSTimeStampToolTip:
Disables automatic timestamp updates on file access in NTFS.
• Improves disk performance by reducing write operations
• The 'Last Accessed' time on files will no longer be updated
• Commonly recommended for performance optimization
chkDisableTelemetryTasksToolTip:
Disables Windows scheduled tasks that collect and send telemetry data.
• Removes data collection tasks from Task Scheduler
• Reduces background CPU and disk usage
• Improves privacy by stopping Microsoft data collection tasks
chkDisableMediaPlayerSharingToolTip:
Disables Windows Media Player's network sharing service.
• Stops WMP from sharing your media library over the network
• Frees up system resources if you don't use network media sharing
• Improves privacy and reduces unnecessary network traffic
chkDisableHomeGroupToolTip:
Disables the HomeGroup networking feature.
• HomeGroup has been removed in Windows 10 v1803+, so this is mainly for older systems
• Stops related services from running in the background
• Use standard workgroup or network sharing instead
chkDisableSMBToolTip:
Disables SMB v1 and v2 network protocols.
• SMB v1 is a legacy protocol with critical vulnerabilities (e.g., WannaCry ransomware)
• SMB v2 is older and less secure than SMB v3
⚠ Warning: Disabling SMB v2 may break file sharing with some older network devices.
chkDisableOfficeTelemetryToolTip:
Disables telemetry and usage data collection in Microsoft Office.
• Stops Office apps from sending usage statistics to Microsoft
• Removes the Office Telemetry Agent scheduled task
• Improves privacy for Office users
chkDisableChromeTelemetryToolTip:
Disables telemetry and crash reporting in Google Chrome via registry policies.
• Prevents Chrome from sending usage statistics and crash reports
• Applied through Windows Group Policy for Chrome
• Improves privacy while using Chrome
chkDisableNvidiaTelemetryToolTip:
Disables NVIDIA's telemetry services that collect GPU usage data.
• Stops NVIDIA Telemetry Container service
• Removes scheduled tasks for NVIDIA data collection
• Slightly reduces background CPU usage from NVIDIA drivers
chkDisableBraveTelemetryToolTip:
Disables telemetry and crash reporting in Brave Browser via registry policies.
• Prevents Brave from sending usage statistics
• Applied through Windows Group Policy for Brave
• Enhances privacy for Brave browser users
chkDisableEdgeTelemetryToolTip:
Disables telemetry and diagnostic data collection in Microsoft Edge.
• Prevents Edge from sending browsing diagnostics to Microsoft
• Applied through Windows Group Policy for Edge
• Recommended for privacy-conscious users
chkDisableVisualStudioTelemetryToolTip:
Disables telemetry in Microsoft Visual Studio and related developer tools.
• Stops VS from sending usage data and crash reports
• Reduces background network activity during development
• Improves privacy for developers
chkDisableMyPeopleToolTip:
Disables the 'My People' feature on the Windows taskbar.
• Removes the People icon from the taskbar
• Stops related background services
• Frees up taskbar space and system resources
chkEnableLongPathsToolTip:
Enables support for file paths longer than 260 characters.
• Required for some development tools (Node.js, Git, Python)
• Prevents 'path too long' errors in deep folder structures
• Highly recommended for developers
chkDisableSensorServicesToolTip:
Disables Windows sensor-related services.
• Stops services for location, ambient light, and motion sensors
• Useful on desktop PCs where sensors are not present
• Reduces unnecessary background services
chkVBSOrVolumeMixerToolTip:
Disables Virtualization Based Security (VBS) on Windows 11.
• VBS can reduce gaming performance by 5-15%
• Disabling it may improve FPS in games
⚠ Warning: Reduces some security protections like HVCI (Memory Integrity).
• Requires a restart to take full effect
chkClassicVolumeMixerToolTip:
Restores the classic Volume Mixer window on Windows 10.
• Replaces the modern slider with the traditional per-app volume mixer
• Allows more granular audio control per application
• Preferred by many power users
chkDisableTelemetryToolTip:
Disables Windows Telemetry services that send diagnostic data to Microsoft.
• Sets telemetry level to minimum (Security)
• Stops DiagTrack (Connected User Experience) service
• Significantly improves privacy
chkDisableCortanaToolTip:
Disables Cortana, Microsoft's digital assistant.
• Stops Cortana from running in the background
• Reduces memory and CPU usage
• Search functionality in the taskbar remains available
chkDisableCopilotToolTip:
Disables Windows Copilot and the Recall AI feature.
• Removes Copilot button from the taskbar
• Disables Recall (AI-powered screenshot history feature)
⚠ Note: Recall has privacy concerns as it screenshots your screen periodically.
chkEnhancePrivacyToolTip:
Applies a collection of privacy-enhancing registry tweaks.
• Disables advertising ID and personalized ads
• Turns off activity history and diagnostic data
• Blocks location tracking and app diagnostics
• Disables cloud content search and suggestions
chkDisableStartMenuAdsToolTip:
Removes advertisements and sponsored suggestions from the Start Menu.
• Disables 'Suggested apps' in Start Menu
• Removes promotional content from Windows
• Cleans up the Start Menu for a professional look
chkEnableGamingModeToolTip:
Enables Windows Game Mode for better gaming performance.
• Prioritizes CPU and GPU resources for the active game
• Reduces background task interference during gaming
• Works best with DirectX games
chkDisableGameBarToolTip:
Disables the Xbox Game Bar overlay (Win+G).
• Removes the overlay that appears during gaming
• Reduces background resource usage from GameDVR
• Recommended if you use third-party capture tools (OBS, etc.)
chkDisableXboxLiveToolTip:
Disables Xbox Live-related services running in the background.
• Stops services: XblAuthManager, XblGameSave, XboxGipSvc
• Reduces idle CPU and memory usage
• Recommended for non-Xbox users
chkDisableMouseAccelerationToolTip:
Disables mouse pointer acceleration (Enhance Pointer Precision).
• Makes mouse movement 1:1 with physical movement
• Essential for competitive gaming (FPS, RTS)
• Improves muscle memory and aiming consistency
chkPauseUpdatesToolTip:
Pauses Windows Update until the year 2036.
• Prevents automatic Windows updates for years
• Uses the registry to set the maximum update pause date
⚠ Warning: Your system will NOT receive security patches during this time.
chkDisableMSStoreUpdatesToolTip:
Disables automatic updates for apps installed from Microsoft Store.
• Prevents Store apps from auto-updating in the background
• Reduces background network and CPU usage
• You can still manually update apps from the Store
chkDisableInsiderServiceToolTip:
Disables the Windows Insider Program service.
• Stops ManagementService for Windows Insider builds
• Prevents enrollment in Insider preview programs
• Recommended for stable production systems
chkExcludeDriversToolTip:
Prevents Windows Update from automatically installing hardware drivers.
• Stops Windows from replacing your manually installed drivers
• Prevents driver downgrades or incompatible driver installations
• Recommended after manually installing GPU or chipset drivers
chkDisableWindowsUpdateToolTip:
Completely disables all Windows Update services.
• Stops wuauserv, WaaSMedicSvc, and related services
• Prevents any automatic updates from running
⚠ CAUTION: This is a major security risk. Use only on isolated systems.
• Also affects some HyperLis features like WSAP
chkAlignTaskbarLeftToolTip:
Moves the taskbar icons back to the left side (Windows 10 style).
• Changes the Start button and icons alignment to the left
• Preferred by users coming from Windows 10
• Applies immediately without restart
chkDisableWidgetsToolTip:
Disables the Widgets panel on the Windows 11 taskbar.
• Removes the Weather/News widget from the taskbar
• Stops the Widgets service from running
• Frees up taskbar space
chkEnableSmallTaskbarIconsToolTip:
Enables smaller taskbar icons for a more compact taskbar.
• Reduces the height of the taskbar
• Provides more screen space
• Popular setting for users with smaller displays
chkDisableChatToolTip:
Disables Microsoft Teams Chat integration on the taskbar.
• Removes the Chat icon from the taskbar
• Stops the Teams background process from auto-starting
• Useful if you don't use Microsoft Teams
chkDisableStickersToolTip:
Disables the Desktop Stickers feature.
• Removes the ability to place stickers on the desktop
• Stops related background processes
• Cleans up the desktop experience
chkFixPinToTaskbarToolTip:
Fixes issues with pinning applications to the taskbar.
• Resolves common 'Pin to taskbar' not working errors
• Updates registry entries for taskbar pinning
• Useful after Windows updates that break this feature
chkDisableNotificationCenterToolTip:
Disables the Windows Notification Center and Toast Notifications.
• Stops notifications from appearing on your screen
• Note: On Windows 11, this may disable the calendar flyout when clicking the clock
• Useful for an uninterrupted experience during gaming or presentations
chkDisableSnapAssistToolTip:
Disables Snap Assist, which shows suggestions when you snap a window.
• Removes the thumbnail popup when snapping windows to edges
• Can feel less intrusive for users who snap frequently
• Window snapping itself still works normally
chkEnableClassicRightClickToolTip:
Restores the classic full right-click context menu on Windows 11.
• Removes the simplified right-click menu introduced in Windows 11
• Shows all options without needing to click 'Show more options'
• Preferred by power users who need full context menu access
chkShowFileExtensionsToolTip:
Makes file extensions visible in File Explorer.
• Shows extensions like .exe, .txt, .jpg on all files
• Helps identify file types and spot malicious files (e.g., .pdf.exe)
• Highly recommended for security awareness
chkEnableCompactModeToolTip:
Enables Compact View in Windows 11 File Explorer.
• Reduces the spacing between items in File Explorer
• Shows more files on screen at once
• Similar to the classic Windows 10 Explorer layout
chkEnableNumLockToolTip:
Enables NumLock automatically when Windows starts.
• Ensures the numeric keypad is active at login
• Saves time for users who frequently use the number pad
• Applied via registry setting
chkShowHiddenFilesToolTip:
Shows hidden files and folders in File Explorer.
• Reveals system files and hidden folders like AppData
• Useful for troubleshooting and advanced file management
⚠ Be careful not to accidentally modify or delete system files.
chkForWorkingToolTip:
Applies a set of optimizations tailored for productivity and office work.
• Balances performance with system stability
• Optimizes memory and process priorities for multitasking
• Safe for daily use on work machines
chkResetToDefaultToolTip:
Resets all Windows tweaks and settings back to their original defaults.
• Reverts all changes made in the Windows tab
• Useful if you experience issues after applying tweaks
• Recommended before major Windows updates
chkForExtremeGamingToolTip:
Applies aggressive performance tweaks for maximum gaming FPS.
• Disables non-essential services and background processes
• Optimizes CPU scheduling, network, and GPU settings
⚠ Warning: Some system features may be disabled. Not recommended for daily work use.
ttNoVolumeFor365: Office 365 does not have a Volume version.
